title: The Ordinary Aftermath
author: Astrid Okonkwo
blurb: Elodie Winterbourne, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
